adapter_attachment.market_input: D2 adapts hftbacktest::types::Event/DataSource into D1 canonical market-event contracts; it does not replace depth processors.
adapter_attachment.command_input: D2 adapts canonical execution commands onto LocalProcessor submit/modify/cancel using checked units and canonical IDs.
adapter_attachment.execution_output: D2 projects kernel Order/State outcomes into canonical execution facts and account/result projections without a second matching/fill ledger.

seams.responsibility: POD market/feed event with exchange/local timestamps, price, quantity and optional L3 order identity.
seams.state_owner: immutable feed fact; processor chooses visible timestamp
seams.determinism: same event bytes and processor role imply the same visible timestamp/flags

seams.responsibility: authoritative market-depth mutation/query interfaces and snapshot application.
seams.determinism: purely driven by ordered event/snapshot inputs plus tick/lot configuration

seams.responsibility: concrete L2/L3 order-book storage and best-level maintenance.
seams.determinism: container choice must not change declared semantic results for identical ordered updates

seams.responsibility: market-event processing, timestamp visibility, order-receipt progression and local submit/modify/cancel seam.
seams.determinism: event_seen_timestamp selects local_ts vs exch_ts explicitly; order-bus progression is timestamp ordered

seams.responsibility: local-view depth/trades/orders/account projection and local-to-exchange order requests.
seams.determinism: local state changes only from local timestamp events and ordered exchange responses

seams.responsibility: L2 exchange-side matching without partial fills; applies queue, latency, depth, fees and fill state.
seams.determinism: same ordered events, model instances/config and initial state imply same fills/order responses

seams.responsibility: L2 exchange-side matching with partial-fill semantics.
seams.determinism: ordered feed + deterministic models define incremental execution outcomes

seams.responsibility: market-by-order local/exchange processing using L3 order identity and FIFO semantics.
seams.determinism: L3 order identity and ordered events fully determine queue evolution

seams.responsibility: bidirectional timestamp-ordered request/response transport between local and exchange processors.
seams.determinism: append enforces nondecreasing timestamp order; latency model fixes delivery timestamps

seams.responsibility: estimate/update order queue position and executable quantity.
seams.state_owner: queue metadata embedded in kernel Order plus selected QueueModel
seams.determinism: same ordered trades/depth changes, initial order state and model parameters imply same queue estimate

seams.responsibility: compute order-entry and response latency, including historical interpolation/rejection convention.
seams.determinism: same model data/config and query sequence imply same latency values

seams.responsibility: calculate execution fees from order/fill state and configured rates.
seams.determinism: deterministic function of order execution fields and fee configuration

seams.responsibility: kernel-local position/balance/fee/trade counters updated from execution fills.
seams.determinism: ordered fills and fixed AssetType/FeeModel deterministically update StateValues

seams.responsibility: load/cache POD event/model data and allow local/exchange processors to consume timestamp views without duplicate reloads.
seams.determinism: file/data identity and preprocessing config must be pinned; parallel loading must not alter event content/order

seams.responsibility: project Bot state/depth into timestamped performance records and serialize CSV/NPZ.
seams.state_owner: derived recorder projection, not execution authority
seams.determinism: same Bot state sampling times imply same record sequence

seams.responsibility: live connector/IPC/bot/recording surfaces.
seams.determinism: external live timing is not replay-deterministic; canonicalization/sequence contracts are required before parity claims

seams.responsibility: Python construction/control surface over native hftbacktest semantics.
seams.state_owner: native kernel; Python is a host/binding surface
seams.determinism: binding must not become a second semantic owner

seams.responsibility: additive binary-contract fee formula quantity * rate * price * (1-price).
seams.state_owner: hftbacktest FeeModel overlay; no separate order state
seams.determinism: pure deterministic function of execution fields/rate

seams.responsibility: convert Polymarket source data to hftbacktest-compatible events.
seams.determinism: same source records/options imply same normalized output

seams.responsibility: preservation evidence for the additive product overlay.
seams.determinism: fixture hashes and expected outputs must remain pinned

required_preservation: incremental execution facts needed by D2 projections
must_not: implement a second matching engine in ChronForge
make concrete depth containers part of ChronForge canonical public contracts
treat backtest recorder as execution authority
make optional live IPC/connectors mandatory for D0-D3
promote Python bindings into native semantic authority
